priority: Player commands and urgent survival gates outrank exploration and any predicted queued activity. Observing is independent of queue space; enqueuing is not.

learned_semantics.tracked_semantic_promotion: Explicit review and validated repository change; no uncontrolled source commits from gameplay
learned_semantics.reviewed_success_requirement: Matched interaction, independently reviewed helpful outcome; minimum three favorable and at least 75% to mark REVIEWED_ASSOCIATION_NOT_GAME_PROOF
learned_semantics.inference: Do not infer an item can satisfy a need merely because a tooltip appeared
learned_semantics.rediscovery: Omit previously observed tooltip targets only on matching exact patch and lot

idle_exploration.require: Named actor, active lot ID, current exact patch, attested camera follow, scene-backed Live mode and reliable double-sampled idle plus exclusive desktop lease
idle_exploration.camera_lease: Bounded existing camera traversal/restore contract; no unscoped pan
idle_exploration.operator_activity: WAITING_FOR_USER without dropping queued in-memory step
idle_exploration.admission: Advisory cannot issue control permit; target-specific adapter separately verifies effect

live_gate: P08 exact patch and disposable-save tests with screenshots of hover, map traversal, queue outcomes, user interruption and camera restoration
